finalText: All 625 tests pass now. The bug was in `orderTotal` (`src/pricing.js`): tax was being calculated on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, violating the "discount first, then tax on what's owed" rule. Only cases where both discount and tax were non-zero exposed it, which is why most of the 625-line output looked fine. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.
